title: Read a query value
summary: Express.js: Read a query value. Visit /search with no query.
introduction: Query values follow ? in a URL. Visit GET /search?q=cat to read q.
learningObjectives: Read a query value with Express.js

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Read a query value

blocks.text: The string check accepts cat as q. The handler puts it under the term field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A query value can have an unexpected shape; check it before use.
